decision.summary: Urgent no-heating job upgraded to emergency because the tenant is vulnerable. HeatRight was assigned after one failed attempt and a verified retry, the tenant was told, then HeatRight no-showed. I recorded the missed appointment, apologised to the tenant and informed the landlord, and escalated P1 to get a backup contractor today.

answers.question: What happened when you assigned the contractor and how did you verify it?
answers.answer: First attempt returned HTTP 500 and the ledger said NOT APPLIED (ticket still init). I retried once; ledger A1 attempt 2 read back stage visit with HeatRight, 2026-10-11 08:00-12:00. Then set_visit was verified (A2).

answers.question: What do you tell the tenant at each point?
answers.answer: After booking: by email (his preference), the visit window Sunday 8am-12pm, someone needs to be home, gas helpline 0800 111 999. After no-show: apology, explanation, emergency handling with a target of within 24h, no invented appointment. The second email timed out, but the read-back showed it was sent (MSG-102), so I did not retry.

answers.question: After the no-show, what do you do?
answers.answer: Recorded missed_appointment (A4), emailed the tenant, informed the landlord (emergencies pre-approved), set a follow-up, and escalated P1 (ESC-105) with Swift as the backup. I did not book Swift myself because no availability is confirmed and I won't invent an appointment.
